TEXT:
[FI] After getting word from Kuroneko, the 
long-awaited day of our date has finally arrived. So, 
we're meeting at...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why is it in front of the school's gate?

[FI] Normally it'll be at the train station... I'd rather meet 
you at your house too.

[FI] I thought about that since I arrived a little early in 
front of the school gate. Then, I doubted what I 
saw, if but just for a moment.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It appears that you have arrived.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Kuroneko...san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Heh... Wrong.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Right now, I'm the "Holy Angel Kamineko". From 
the family of darkness, I have been reborn as a 
white angel.

[FI] My question was answered by the full throttle of 
Chuunibyou nonsense.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No... You're Kuroneko, no matter how you look at it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Tch, didn't I say that's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No no, Kuroneko. What on earth is with that get-up-

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You're repetitive.

[FI] Seems like I won't get through to her if I don't 
play along.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Alright, Kamineko...san? There's something I wish to 
know, is that okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Fufu, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's with that get-up?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It is the garments of the Holy Angel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Since when did you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] I started working on it since the day we went 
shellfish gathering.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You only took two days?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] One thing led to another, I spent two sleepless 
nights making it.
[FI] ...She worked that hard on it, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] And so... How about it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Do you not have any thoughts after seeing this 
outfit?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...You look cute.

[FI] It had a certain kind of eccentric charm compared 
to her usual Gothic Lolita outfit, this has its own 
unique flavor to it. However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But, those wings and such... what's with those?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] After the class change from a Fallen Angel into a 
Holy Angel, it materialized itself as a symbol.
[FI] I can't understand any of this... Hang on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You're not going on a date today dressed like that, 
are you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Of course, I plan to. Is there a problem?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It looks good on you, but wouldn't that stand out a 
bit too much?

[FI] Going on a date with that outfit... That's pretty 
tough.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I'll go change out of this and come back.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, you don't have to change...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But you look so troubled over it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Urgh...
[FI] Crap, so it was written all over my face...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Anyway, just wait here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...At least let me walk you home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You can't.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] After all... isn't that more befitting for a date?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Did I just say something I shouldn't have?

[FI] It looks like that outfit was made for the sake of 
showing it to me.

[FI] But stuff like going on a first date with my 
girlfriend cosplaying as an angel with wings 
attached, it's beyond me.

[FI] Still, Kuroneko's pretty cute in that outfit too, so I 
should encourage her to wear that again sometime.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...It appears that you have arrived.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Huh? Erm, didn't you say that earlie... eh? Umm, 
Kuroneko...san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Do I look like anyone else to you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, that outfit...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] W-What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What kind of cosplay is it this time?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] I-It's not cosplay... it's just normal clothes, casual 
clothing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] S-Sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] And so... How about it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Do you not have any thoughts after seeing this 
outfit?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...You look cute.

[FI] This conversation is giving me a huge sense of Déjà 
vu somehow... Could it be she's shrugging off what 
happened earlier?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It's quite a different impression from before 
though... I didn't know you have such clothes too.

[FI] It's certainly cute, but quite different from the 
usual Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...This outfit was picked out by your sister, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] By Kirino?

[FI] I see. As expected from her modeling experience. 
With just clothes, an impression is easily changed...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, I'm glad you two seem to be getting along.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Hmph, I wish you wouldn't take our friendship that 
lightly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see. Thanks.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...W-Well, let us be off, then. We're taking the train, 
aren't we?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Nah, we won't be taking the train today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Aren't we going to Akihabara like usual?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If so, it'll be the same as before we started dating, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That... that might be true...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Besides, wouldn't it be useful for your stories? 
Knowing what lovers normally do on a date?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...In other words, you wish to go on a "normal date" 
with me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's one way to put it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Goodness, even though there are some shops that I 
would like to visit at Akihabara today...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...I guess you would prefer it if it's Akihabara?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I never said anything of the sort.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But you just...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] As long as you're together with me, I'll be happy 
no matter where we go, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Well, these experiences are good from time to time. 
You'll give me a proper escort in return, won't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, yeah, of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That's... Hey, how about stuff like a pilgrimage to 
the holy land of Anime!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] That isn't really a place where you would go on a 
date with a lover...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Urgh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...Well, I can't blame you. It's not like you just started 
being pitiable today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I like that part of you too, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What? Are you blushing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Leave me alone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh my, are you sulking already?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm not sulking at all!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So, where do we go first then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] For starters, let's head towards the station.

[FI] I started walking alongside Kuroneko, our steps 
matching.
